name: TributeCore B2B
author: dziubin

sections.description:
TributeCore B2B by PluginSprint is a premium, empathetic, and beautifully designed digital memorial platform tailored for funeral homes, crematoriums, and memorial service providers.

Offer your clients a modern way to honor their loved ones. TributeCore allows you to generate dedicated, highly visual tribute pages where friends and family can leave condolences, share memories, and light interactive virtual candles.

Built with performance and aesthetics in mind, this plugin introduces breathtaking “Glassmorphism” visual themes and operates entirely via seamless AJAX – meaning no page reloads for your users.

Key Features

  • Interactive Virtual Candles: Visitors can light a beautiful, CSS-animated virtual candle that remains lit for 24 hours, bringing life and ongoing engagement to the memorial page.
  • Integrated Guestbook: A built-in condolences system powered by AJAX. Messages are seamlessly sent to your native WordPress Comments dashboard for easy moderation.
  • 3 Premium Visual Themes: Choose between ‘Premium Glassmorphism’, ‘Minimalist Light’, or ‘Elegant Dark’ to perfectly match the mood and branding of your website.
  • Frontend Submission Form: Allow your clients to submit new memorials directly from your website using the [tributecore_form] shortcode. Choose to auto-publish or hold for admin review.
  • 1-Click Demo Generator: Instantly populate your site with 3 beautiful, realistic demo tributes to see the plugin in action immediately.
  • Zero Bloat & Pure CSS: No heavy image assets for the candles or themes. Everything is rendered using modern, lightweight CSS for blazing-fast load times.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the tributecore-b2b folder to your /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to the PluginSprint -> TributeCore Settings menu in your WordPress dashboard.
  4. Select your preferred Visual Theme and frontend submission settings.
  5. Create a new Page (e.g., “Memorial Board”) and add the shortcode [tributecore] to display the grid of tributes.
  6. (Optional) Create a “Submit a Tribute” page and add the shortcode [tributecore_form].
sections.faq:
How do I moderate the condolences left by visitors?

All guestbook entries are sent directly to your native WordPress “Comments” section. By default, they are set to “Pending” so you can review and approve them before they appear publicly on the tribute page.

Can clients submit their own memorials?

Yes! Simply place the [tributecore_form] shortcode on any page. You can configure the plugin to either publish these submissions instantly or hold them as “Drafts” for your review.

How long does a virtual candle stay lit?

When a visitor clicks to light a candle, the flame will remain actively lit and counted on the memorial page for exactly 24 hours.

  • Feature: Frontend grid and single tribute views with 3 dynamic visual themes.
  • Feature: Interactive, 24-hour virtual pure CSS candles with AJAX counting.
  • Feature: Guestbook and Condolences system integrated with native WP comments.
  • Feature: Frontend submission form for new memorials.
